project_name.description: OpenStack project name (used for paths, user/group names, config file paths, etc.)

system_user.description: System user account under which the daemon runs

system_group.description: System group for the daemon user

config_file.description: Path to the main configuration file

script_name.description: Path to the init script file

polling_namespaces.description: Polling namespaces to use for the daemon

use_syslog.description:
Whether to use syslog (set to 'yes' to enable)
enum: ["yes", "no"]

use_logfile.description:
Whether to use logfile (set to 'no' to disable)
enum: ["yes", "no"]

pyargv.description: Arguments passed to the Python interpreter via --pyargv

uwsgi_port.description: UWSGI port number (empty string disables UWSGI mode)

uwsgi_ini_app.description: Path to UWSGI app INI file
